mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_quota(user_id, used_bytes, asset_count) VALUES (#{userId}, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media_quota WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE media_quota SET used_bytes = used_bytes - #{bytes}, asset_count = asset_count - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used_bytes >= #{bytes} AND asset_count > 0
